summary: Iterates over provided cart items, fetching each product by SKU and invoking its release with the item quantity to update product state.
inputs: self (ProductCatalog): Catalog instance providing get(sku) to retrieve products and orchestrate releases.
items (List[CartItem]): Iterable of CartItem objects, each with sku and qty to release.
outputs: side_effects (SideEffect): For each item, calls Product.release with the specified quantity, potentially mutating product inventory/reservation state.
main_effect: Invoke <SPL>commerce_ops_demo.commerce_ops.models.Product.release</SPL> with item.qty to release the quantity for the retrieved product.
errors: <SPL>commerce_ops_demo.commerce_ops.catalog.ProductCatalog.get</SPL> or <SPL>commerce_ops_demo.commerce_ops.models.Product.release</SPL> raises an underlying domain/runtime exception
<SPL>commerce_ops_demo.commerce_ops.catalog.ProductCatalog.get</SPL> returns None or a non-product object lacking release
An element in items lacks sku or qty (e.g., item.sku or item.qty is missing)
AttributeError: Raised when item does not provide the expected attributes sku or qty.
AttributeError: Raised when the retrieved product is None or lacks a release method.
Exception: Propagated exception from get or release indicating retrieval or release failure.
TypeError: Raised by Python when attempting to iterate over a non-iterable items argument.
items is not iterable and the for-loop cannot begin iteration
